subject: im
question: What is a BOM (Bill of Materials)?
title: BOM: The Recipe Card
hook: A factory needs a recipe too.
answer: BOM (Bill of Materials): the complete list of raw materials, components and sub-assemblies, with the quantity of each, needed to make ONE unit of a product.
It is drawn as a product structure tree.
Level 0 = end item (finished product); Level 1 = sub-assemblies; Level 2 = raw parts.
Each branch carries a quantity (chair: 1 seat, 1 back; back: 3 slats, 4 screws).
It is the key input to MRP, which multiplies it by the quantity ordered to plan what to buy.
